items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-04-02
items.q: The interviewer mentions Arnold DePass/DePox and asks 'Do you remember who else was in those bands? No. That early band, Arnold DePox?' The interviewee does not confirm personal interaction or membership in the band, only responding to the interviewer's narrative.

ctx.x: He used to play those fraternity dances at any time all along St. Charles Avenue. You know, and you get all those fraternities, different organizations. And that's how I began to play out, like one job to another.
Do you remember who else was in those bands? No. That early band, Arnold DePox?

There's a, let me see, a guy which is called Bill Phillips, drummer. I don't know if he's working anymore, if he's still living. You see that drummer. I heard the door. I don't know if he's in sax. Oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh. Don't you remember when you work with Billy? The old man, he smoked him in cigarettes.
